correctness.rationale: Putting t=x², the branch polynomial divided by t² is Q(t+t⁻¹) with Q(z)=z²+az+b-2. Since no root t is zero and t→t+t⁻¹ ramifies only over z=±2, Q must have distinct roots and avoid those two values. Disc(Q) and Q(±2) give exactly the three excluded factors in characteristic 5. The coefficients of f² at degrees 2,4,8,12,14 give the indicated 3-by-3 matrix: the 4 and 12 entries are a²+2b, 2 and 14 are 2a, and 8 is b²+2a²+2. Its ± basis on the outer indices and its middle vector are defined over F_5; thus every nonzero Hasse scalar stays nonzero under the twisted iterations and both rank formulas follow. Eliminating b via H_+=0 gives b=2a²+4a and H_0=4(a-1)³(a+2), with the symmetric formula for H_-. The triple intersections in the eliminant sense are at excluded boundary points; the other roots are simple, so the two smooth divisors cross transversally at each surviving point. H_+ and H_- cross at (0,0) with independent gradients, and H_0 there is nonzero. This also verifies there is no point with three vanishing factors. The Newton rows follow independently of the isogeny citation: rank is at least one, leaving at most four slopes between 0 and 1; any non-half slope and its dual require total multiplicity at least six. For counts, the three boundary graphs have q points each, three rational pairwise crossings and no triple point. On H_+, the boundary parabola and one boundary line give only (1,1), and the other line gives a²+a+1=0. H_- follows by a→-a. On H_0 insertion of the boundary parabola gives (a²-1)², while the lines give (a±1)², so only (±1,1) are lost in the affine chart. At infinity the smooth projective conic loses two points exactly when 3 is a square, i.e. in even extension degree, the same parity as square discriminant 2 for the other two intersections. Hence each retained divisor has q-1-2δ_n points. Subtract the three rational crossing points twice from the divisor incidence count to count points on precisely one divisor, then subtract from |U|. This establishes the three formulas for marked pairs in every extension.
residual_risks: The script's matrix comparison is on 25 coefficient specializations and its census uses the derived formulas for ranks in three fields; it is not a symbolic proof or coverage of all extensions. The coefficient calculation, eliminations and conic point count above justify those steps. The nodes are intersections of divisors, not singular fibers on U.

value.rationale: On a standard genus-three reciprocal Howe family, the rank strata are described by an explicit transverse Hasse-divisor arrangement and an exact marked census. The parity correction pinpoints field-of-definition effects invisible in a geometric census, and gives a reproducible benchmark for the frequency of ordinary and mixed-slope behaviors over every extension. This is material arithmetic information even after crediting the prior geometry and the isomorphism of the rank-one fibers.
residual_risks: No claim of a count of distinct Jacobian or curve isomorphism classes, nor of a general genus-three moduli census.
